key_idea: Turning over the right edge gives the same picture as turning over the top edge and then spinning it halfway around.
steps: In the house we see, the roof is on top and the chimney is on the left.
Turning the card over its right edge instead is like turning it over the top edge and then spinning it upside down.
Spinning halfway around puts the roof at the bottom and moves the chimney to the right side.
Picture D shows the roof at the bottom with the chimney on the right.

choice_feedback.A: The roof is still on top. Only the chimney moved to the right.
choice_feedback.B: This is the same house we get by turning over the top edge.
choice_feedback.C: The roof is at the bottom, but the chimney is still on the left.
choice_feedback.E: This house is turned on its side.
